programs.title: EMI
programs.desc: A film that tells the story of a group of people who fall prey to credit card debt and are struggling to repay their loans. They come together to form a support group and devise a plan to fight against the corrupt practices of the credit card companies. The movie highlights the consequences of reckless spending and the importance of financial literacy in an engaging and thought-provoking plot.
